description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: Enhancing Nuclear Safety and Reliability: Identifying Human Failure Events for External Hazard Probabilistic Risk Assessment is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Camille Levine, University of Maryland College Park (umd.edu). This poster describes the identification of human failure events for external flood hazard mitigation actions at a nuclear power plant. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-sh0e-sd85. Keywords: human reliability analysis, nuclear power plant, external flooding, human failure events. Published 2024-06-18. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
